blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — A P75-million disaster-resilient evacuation center is being built in Can-avid, Eastern Samar, marking the first Ligtas Pinoy Center project in Eastern Visayas under the national government’s effort to provide safer and better-equipped shelters during emergencies. Can-avid Mayor Alicia Teves led the groundbreaking ceremony in Barangay 5 on Nov.23, along with Office of Civil Defense (OCD) Administrator and Undersecretary Harold Cabreros, Eastern Samar Gov. Ralph Vincent Evardone, and representatives of the Regional Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council (RDRRMC)-8 member agencies.
